A '''boarding craft''' was a craft used for boarding enemy [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] and [[Space station/Legends|stations]].

*[[Spiral-class Assault Ship|''Spiral''-class Assault Ship]]

*[[Imperial Drill Pod Boarding Craft]]
